title: Enforce credits before generation
description: Allow uploads even when the user has no credits, but block POST /api/generations unless the authenticated user's wallet balance is at least 1. Return a clear insufficient-credit error. Preserve the current business rule that one credit is charged only after a generation job completes successfully, and do not charge for failed jobs.
close_reason: Implemented wallet ledger, credit enforcement, fake top-ups, wallet/admin visibility, manual grants, upload UI wallet UX, and wallet regression coverage. Verified with npm run lint, npm test, and npm run build.

title: Store preview GLBs alongside original model assets
description: Add the storage and persistence shape needed to keep lightweight preview GLBs separate from original full-quality model files. Scope includes naming conventions, storage keys, database/store references, and retrieval behavior for preview assets without regressing existing download flows.
acceptance_criteria: Preview assets have a defined storage/persistence model, original download assets remain unchanged, and retrieval paths can distinguish preview vs full model assets.
close_reason: Added versioned preview storage keys, generated sample preview GLBs, persisted job preview_asset_id separately from result_asset_id, exposed previewUrl while preserving full download resultUrl.

title: Use preview GLBs for homepage gallery delivery
description: Update the homepage/gallery delivery path to request lightweight preview GLBs instead of full-size model assets. Scope includes URL selection, fallback behavior, and cache expectations so the gallery can stop loading heavyweight sample models by default.
acceptance_criteria: Homepage gallery requests preview GLBs by default, fallback behavior is defined, and asset delivery no longer depends on full-size sample models for the marquee.
close_reason: Homepage gallery now rewrites sample URLs to versioned preview GLBs, sample route allowlists preview assets with bounded fallback, and generated preview files are present for all marquee models.

title: Define glTF Transform preview compression pipeline
description: Establish the repeatable glTF Transform workflow for generating lightweight preview GLBs from larger source GLBs. Cover the chosen transforms, quality/size targets, command integration point, and how preview generation failures should be handled without breaking original downloads.
acceptance_criteria: A documented pipeline exists for preview GLB generation, preview outputs are materially smaller than source models, and the implementation path is clear for worker/script integration.
close_reason: Defined and implemented preview GLB pipeline with glTF Transform, generated materially smaller sample previews, documented commands/failure behavior, and verified lint/tests/build.

title: Generate lightweight preview GLBs with glTF Transform
description: Add a preview-model optimization step for gallery/sample assets using glTF Transform so the app can serve lightweight .glb files separately from full-quality download models. Scope should cover choosing a repeatable compression pipeline (for example simplify, geometry compression, and texture compression), defining preview output naming/storage conventions, and wiring the preview assets into the gallery delivery path without replacing the original result downloads.
close_reason: Closed all child work: glTF Transform pipeline, preview storage/persistence, generated sample previews, and homepage gallery delivery using preview GLBs. Verified lint, tests, build, and size reductions.

title: Wallet regression coverage

close_reason: Implemented wallet ledger, credit enforcement, fake top-ups, wallet/admin visibility, manual grants, upload UI wallet UX, and wallet regression coverage. Verified with npm run lint, npm test, and npm run build.

close_reason: Implemented wallet ledger, credit enforcement, fake top-ups, wallet/admin visibility, manual grants, upload UI wallet UX, and wallet regression coverage. Verified with npm run lint, npm test, and npm run build.

title: Fix single-image face submit value

Normalize the single-image face value to the numeric Hi3D contract for new jobs and keep legacy queued/retried jobs working.

title: Fix Hi3D real API contract

title: Rename visible Hi3D branding to Ab3ad3d
